title: LOGOS ASF — TR-06D Live Evaluation Execution Report
description: Contract for the result of executing a TR-06C live evaluation plan against a deterministic local stub adapter. In TR-06D, only stub adapters are allowed. No real model inference, provider calls, or model weight loads occur.

execution_report_id.description: Deterministic ID. Format: XR-<sha256[:16]>. Stable for same plan_id and sorted case result hashes.

live_eval_plan_id.description: LP-* plan this report corresponds to.

adapter_id.description: Identifier of the adapter used. In TR-06D: TR06D_STUB_ADAPTER_001.

adapter_type.description: Class of adapter that ran. deterministic_stub is the only allowed type in TR-06D.

adapter_mode.description: Execution mode. local_stub_only is the operative mode in TR-06D.

execution_status.description: Outcome of the plan execution attempt.

cases_executed.description: Number of cases for which a result was recorded.

stub_response_hash.description: SHA-256 of the deterministic stub response text.

rubric_reference.description: Which rubric criterion was used to assign the result.

requires_live_inference.description: Always true — these plans come from TR-06C cases that require live inference. The stub adapter is a placeholder, not real inference.

real_model_inference_performed.description: Always false in TR-06D. No real model inference occurred.

provider_calls_performed.description: Always false in TR-06D. No provider calls occurred.

model_weights_loaded.description: Always false in TR-06D. No model weights were loaded.

promotion_blocked.description: Always true. No execution report can emit a promotion decision.

promotion_decision_emitted.description: Always false. TR-06D never emits a promotion decision.

operator_review_required.description: Always true. Operator must review stub execution results before any further action.

blocked_actions.description: Actions this execution was blocked from performing.

notes.description: Free-text notes about this execution report.

x-invariants.no_real_inference: real_model_inference_performed is const:false. No model was invoked.
x-invariants.no_provider_calls: provider_calls_performed is const:false. No provider SDK calls occurred.
x-invariants.no_model_weights: model_weights_loaded is const:false. No weights were loaded or referenced by path.
x-invariants.promotion_blocked_const: promotion_blocked is const:true. Stub execution cannot promote a candidate.
x-invariants.operator_review_required: operator_review_required is const:true. Stub results require human review.
x-invariants.no_tr07: TR-07 shadow/canary was not started here.
x-invariants.no_training: No real training occurred in TR-06D.
x-invariants.no_store1: No Store 1 writes occurred in TR-06D.
